In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the combined compression/ejection cycle is an interesting alternative for simultaneous production of refrigeration and low-temperature cold, and it is especially suitable for low-temperature heat source utilization.

the use of environment friendly refrigerants R152a and HFO1234yf is recommended in this type of combined compression/ejection systems, especially for the case when the temperature level of freezing is lower than -20°C, and for a wide range of ambient temperatures.
the proposed cycle is capable of operating with environment friendly refrigerants and can be used for the simultaneous production both of cold for refrigerating and freezing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed combined compression/ejection cycle can achieve a high coefficient of performance (COP) of about 3, and a high energy saving of about 30%, compared to the conventional vapor compression refrigeration cycle.

the use of environment friendly refrigerant R290 in the combined compression/ejection cycle is the most suitable for the simultaneous production in a single system of refrigeration at a temperature of 5°C and freezing at −25°C.
the combined cycle can be operated with environment friendly refrigerants and can provide a good compromise between the performance and the refrigerant charge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combined compression/ejection cycle can be successfully applied to produce simultaneously cold for refrigeration at a temperature of 5°C and cold for freezing at −18°C.
the combined cycle is able to provide the same cooling capacity as the two-stage vapor compression cycle while consuming less mechanical energy.

, in the case of the combined compression/ejection cycle using the environment friendly refrigerants, the cooling capacity for refrigeration can be significantly increased by using the ejector, and the system COP is improved.
